about:
Finetex Textile Group operates from Lebanon, Pennsylvania, where it provides full-service textile manufacturing and fabric printing. The company's leadership includes David Hammond as vice president of manufacturing and Maria Hammond in customer support, alongside Chad Zhang. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The facility handles all types of fabrics and printing methods, offering roll-to-roll heat transfer sublimation printing merged with roto gravure technology, plus cut-and-sew operations with no minimum or maximum job size. Services span designing, engineering, engraving, setup, jet-printed fabrics, and prototyping, allowing customers to move quickly from concept to production.

Finetex serves apparel brands and licensees seeking licensed art and color reproductions on fabric, producing items such as children's shorts, briefs, and gym shorts. Its customer base includes companies needing rapid product-to-market cycles while developing their own patterns.

The company emphasizes its ability to manage every stage of textile production under one roof, from artwork reproduction to finished garment assembly, positioning itself as a single-source partner capable of handling any job size without imposing minimum order constraints.
